listing.name: Guardian Prototype 1.3
listing.summary: Adds a customizable Guardian ship with multiple variants, a bridge, and a blueprint for building and flying it.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a customizable Guardian ship with multiple variants, a bridge, and a blueprint for building and flying it.

description:
Guardian Prototype

Download:Github

Ever wanted to fly a Guardian? well now you can!

This mod adds a separate Guardian that has a bridge built on to it, it comes with a blueprint, it has the Automated ship hull mod removed so the player can fly it.

It is 80dp to field instead of the normal 40dp because its keeping its autoforge and will be WAY stronger in the players hands, also its 1.5mil to build.

Credits

Yunru- For making the mod

YuiTheModder- For doing all the sprite work.

My other mod- Radiant Prototype

My other mod- Tesseract Prototype

ChangeLog-1.3- Added 3 new variants of the Guardian

* Full Energy variant 60dp 1mil to build

* Full Ballistic variant 60dp 1mil to build

* Full Missile variant 160dp 3.5mil to build

1.1 updated mod name to Guardian Prototype from "Human Guardian"

aiDescription: Adds a Guardian ship with a built-in bridge and a blueprint for building it, allowing players to fly it directly. Includes three new variants: Full Energy, Full Ballistic, and Full Missile, each with different stats and costs. The ship is designed to be stronger than standard ships, with a 80dp field size and a 1.5 million credit build cost.
